visualCharacteristics: Centered pull-quote: a large quotation in body type wrapped in typographic quote marks, followed by an em-dash attribution line in uppercase heading type. An optional second attribution line (role/title) renders in muted body type. Max-width 900px, centered.
contentPattern: Two rows: the first cell is the quotation, the second (optional) cell is the attribution (name, optionally a second line for role/title).
usage: Highlight a testimonial or notable quotation with an attribution line.
